diagnosis: The CrmNotePolicy view method treats the 'is_public' flag as globally readable without restricting reads to users within the same enterprise account. Since 'is_public' notes were meant to be visible to all agents within the note author's tenant, agents from rival companies can read all notes flagged as public.
